checkpoints.step: After Brexit, the UK has its own version of EU261 (UK261 / "Retained EU Law").
checkpoints.expected: The system needs to check BOTH: - NE-06: Did the flight start in the EU/EEA? ? NO - NE-07: Did the flight start in the UK? ? NO These are separate checks because: - A flight from CDG (Paris) to YYZ qualifies under EU261 but NOT UK261 - A flight from LHR (London) to YYZ qualifies under UK261 but NOT EU261 - A flight from YYZ to LHR qualifies under NEITHER (non-EU carrier departing from non-EU) NE-06 tests the EU gate. NE-07 tests the UK gate specifically. In this case, YUL?LHR fails BOTH gates because Canada is neither EU nor UK. � All further checks SKIPPED: ? Controllability � SKIPPED ? Notification � SKIPPED ? No-travel � SKIPPED DDS RESPONSE CODE = SoC-EU-NE-07

Since your flight did not depart from the UK, your claim is not eligible under UK regulations. However, your flight may be eligible under Canadian regulations (APPR). Would you like us to check your eligibility under APPR instead?"
